howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: Two recorded walks: create a tournament, then join one through pick & ban to the end.
howItWorks.creatorIntro: Organizer video: from creation to launching drafts.
howItWorks.videoHintCreator: Recorded demo: sign in, create the tournament, registrations, check-in, start, drafts and score entry up to the final bracket.
howItWorks.creatorStep1: Sign in, then create a tournament (solo or teams) from the dashboard.
howItWorks.creatorStep2: Open registration and fill teams/players up to the minimum (8 teams).
howItWorks.creatorStep3: Move to check-in: each captain confirms their team is present.
howItWorks.creatorStep4: Start the tournament (IN_PROGRESS): the bracket is generated automatically.
howItWorks.creatorStep5: From the draft section, launch drafts for the current round matches.
howItWorks.creatorStep6: Enter scores after drafts finish, through finals and prize distribution.
howItWorks.playerIntro: Player video: register, check in, ban/pick, then play.
howItWorks.videoHintPlayer: Recorded demo: team registration, check-in, full ban & pick phase, match chat, then the bracket until the end of the tournament.
howItWorks.playerStep1: Create or join a 4-player team (Tank / Support / DPS roles).
howItWorks.playerStep2: Register your team during the registration phase.
howItWorks.playerStep3: At check-in, the captain confirms the team is present.
howItWorks.playerStep4: When the tournament starts, open your match and the captain draft link.
howItWorks.playerStep5: Ban phase (45s): 1 Tank, 1 Support, 2 DPS. If nobody picks, the first available hero in each shuffled group is auto-banned.
howItWorks.playerStep6: Pick phase: build your roster (1 Tank, 1 Support, 2 DPS) in draft order.
howItWorks.playerStep7: Play the match, follow the bracket, until elimination or the win.
howItWorks.draftRuleBan: Each team bans 4 heroes: 1 Tank, 1 Support, 2 DPS, alternating turns.
howItWorks.draftRuleTimer: Each ban has 45 seconds. The countdown is shown on the draft board.
howItWorks.draftRuleAuto: On timeout, the system bans the first still-available hero in the next incomplete role (Tank → Support → DPS), then the next one if needed (e.g. 2nd DPS ban).
howItWorks.draftRuleShuffle: Hero order inside each role section is shuffled every draft so the same character is not always first.
howItWorks.draftRulePick: After bans: pick order 1 → 2 → 2 → 2 → 1, with 4 picks per team.
